answer_1.quote: We tackle the problem of automatic generation of football commentary... We build commentary generators based on OpenAI's GPT-4o and evaluate their performance.
answer_1.outputs: Japanese live commentary sentences synchronized with match events

answer_4.quote: We assess three aspects-Accuracy, Relevance, and Ease of Understanding... Human evaluation shows that the plain-text encoding already outperforms the image and hybrid variants.
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluated each generated commentary on Accuracy, Relevance, and Ease of Understanding using a 3-point rating scale.
